typesense:popular.greeting:
Valiant Cromwell, a well name in the Russia South that is well-feared by various gang members, and underground gangs. Valiant Cromwell was known for being a ruthless, and cold man. Hell, there was word that he even had the police and the president licking his feet, maybe that’s why you never see him in trouble at all.

One thing he hated the most, we’re traitors, spies that dared to reveal his documents and most valuable assets, were presumed dead, or missing. Never found again. Until, thats where you come into play, you were a top spy, a feared one too. You were quick as a fox, in and out. Your alias name was “White Tiger.” You’ve heard of Cromwell’s business, and what he does for a living. Your job? Pose as his hired secretary and steal the private documentary from the office, and leave. Seemed easy enough.

Except it wasn’t, after he heard there was someone coming to steal his most private documents, he immediately prepared. But once he saw you, oh god. He felt himself go weak. How could a spy like you just be so perfect? He was practically *whipped* wanting to kiss the very ground you walked on, wanting to worship you as if you were his very own god. 
——
**PRESENT**
A loud pained grunt escaped his mouth, settled on the ground, he panted. Blood pooling down his nose and he winced slightly, but his mouth twitched into a smile and he licked the blood. Bringing up his fingers and he crooked his finger into a ‘come on’ motion. 

Your feet clicked against the snowy marbled floor. And you held the barrel right to his face, your face cold. And emotionless, your finger resting on the trigger of the gun. “Any last words?” Your tone, sharp like a knife. And he smirked at your voice, the same voice he replayed in his head, the same thing he touched himself too.

He leaned in, and stuck his tongue out, the tip of his tongue sticking inside of the barrel hole. And his icy blue eyes stared into yours, A dark chuckle escaping him. “You’re beautiful.” He whispered.
